- Du bringst Erfahrung in internationalen Projektumfeldern sowie Bereitschaft zu Reisen innerhalb Europas mit.
- Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch und Englischkenntnisse
- Deine offene Denkweise, Hands-on-Mentalität und Freude an teamorientierter Zusammenarbeit zeichnen Dich aus.

Des Weiteren gibt es 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, weitere Urlaubstage bei besonderen familiären Umständen sowie verschiedene Sabbatical-Optionen.

L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us. Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognised as one of the industry's best firms to work for. This role sits within our Generalist team, working across Healthcare, Industrials, Education, Technology and Consumer.
- Broad exposure to different markets, business models and strategic challenges
- Strong focus on PE and transaction advisory, supporting investors across the deal cycle
- Regular interaction with leading investors and management teams
- Rapid development of experience across industries and investment contexts

- Lead defined workstreams or modules within a project, taking responsibility for the quality and timely delivery of assigned work

- Work with case team members to translate research and analysis into clear conclusions and recommendations for clients

- Ensure analysis and data collection are accurate, well documented and supported by clear methodologies and sources
- Review and quality-check own work, taking responsibility for its accuracy and reliability
- Manage priorities and time effectively, meeting agreed deadlines and proactively flagging risks or bottlenecks to the case team
- Contribute positively to the wider team, including supporting and coaching more junior colleagues and new joiners

- Commitment to maintaining L.E.K.’s standards of professionalism, integrity and confidentiality at all times
- Intellectual curiosity, resourcefulness and creativity in identifying information and approaching complex problems
- Ability to synthesise complex or large amounts of information into clear, practical insights
- Strong attention to detail, with ownership of the accuracy and quality of their work
- Organised, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines effectively
- Clear and professional communication with colleagues, clients and external interviewees
- Collaborative approach, contributing positively to a high-performing team

Company Description
About Sia
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.
Strategy & Management Consulting
Sia’s Strategy & Management Consulting global footprint and expertise in more than 40 sectors and services allow us to enhance our clients' businesses worldwide. We guide their projects and initiatives in strategy, business transformation, IT & digital strategy.
Financial Institutions have drastically changed over the last decade, driven by increased regulatory constraints, diverse competition inside and beyond traditional banking organizations, and emerging technologies reshaping long-standing ecosystems. Sia’s Financial Services Business Unit provides a comprehensive suite of core capabilities designed to address the diverse and evolving needs of our clients, enabling them to navigate complex challenges, seize new opportunities, and achieve their strategic objectives in an increasingly competitive and dynamic business environment.

Job Description
We are seeking a highly motivated Consultant to join our Financial Services Consulting practice as a Forward Deployed Business Analyst (FDBA). Whether your expertise lies in wealth and asset management, capital markets, corporate banking, risk and compliance or other areas in financial services, we want to hear from you. 
This is not a traditional Business Analyst role. As a FDBA, you will be embedded with client teams to own business outcomes, not just document requirements. You will leverage data, analytics and AI as a core part of your workflow to move faster, think deeper , and deliver smarter solutions and meaningful transformation across financial services organizations. 
You will act as a strategic advisor, AI operator , and execution partner, using AI to eliminate administrative work and focus your time on enhanced decision making, problem-solving, stakeholder alignment, operational efficiency and solution design. 
Responsibilities:
- AI-Enabled Consulting Delivery: Apply traditional consulting tools and emerging AI-enabled, no-code, low-code, automation, and analytics platforms to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, prototyping, process mapping, stakeholder alignment, and delivery execution while including defining agent responsibilities, decision boundaries, escalation paths, and human-in-the-loop controls to ensure safe, reliable, and compliant operation within financial services environments. 
- Client Engagement & Delivery: Work directly with client business, operations, product, data, and technology teams to understand strategic objectives, operational challenges, technical constraints, stakeholder priorities, and desired business outcomes. 
- Strategic Problem Solving: Assess current-state processes, systems, data flows, risks, dependencies, and pain points to identify root causes, evaluate business impacts, and help define the design and implementation of strategic initiatives that incorporate both traditional and AI-enabled strategic solutions (e.g., operating model transformation, system implementations, process optimization) 
- Technical Business Analysis: Translate business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, process flows, data requirements, business rules, acceptance criteria, and solution documentation that bridge business stakeholders and technical delivery teams with the support of internal and client-approved AI solutions. 
- Solution Design & Implementation Support: Partner with product owners, engineers, architects, data teams, and client stakeholders to support solution design system implementation, workflow optimization, integration planning, UAT, validation, and implementation readiness across front, middle, and back-office platforms including .targeted use cases of AI- or agent-enabled solutions. 
- Workstream Ownership & Execution: Own assigned tasks and deliverables by managing timelines, tracking risks, issues, decisions, and dependencies, proactively communicating progress, and helping drive initiatives from analysis through execution. 
- Client-Ready Communication & Deliverables: Prepare structured, accurate, and polished materials, including presentations, executive summaries, business cases, impact assessments, process documentation, status reports, meeting outputs, and stakeholder communications for internal teams, client stakeholders, and senior leaders. 
- Internal Firm Support: Support proposals and business development initiatives, including client presentations and thought leadership, contributing perspectives on digital, data, and AI trends within financial services.

Qualifications
These qualifications are intended to reflect what may help someone succeed as a Consultant at Sia. We recognize that candidates may not meet every qualification listed, and we encourage you to apply if you are excited about the role, eager to learn, and believe you can contribute to our teams and clients. 
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, AI Engineering & Computing, Computer Science, Data Science, Financial Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred. 
- Relevant Experience: Recent graduate or early-career candidate with up to 2 years of post-graduate experience, including internships, academic projects, or work experience demonstrating business problem-solving, analytical thinking, professional communication, AI-enabled ways of working, and a proactive, forward-deployed BA mindset; experience in financial services or management consulting is preferred.
- AI-Enabled Technical Proficiency: Foundational ability to leverage AI/GenAI tools, prompt engineering, and modern productivity platforms to accelerate business analysis, requirements gathering, process documentation, research, testing support, and stakeholder-ready deliverables, while applying sound judgment to validate and improve AI-generated outputs through responsible AI governance concepts. 
- Traditional Technical Proficiency: Ability to use Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Visio, JIRA / Confluence, Microsoft PowerBI /, Tableau, SQL and other related tools to support advanced data analysis, develop insights and analytics, and create clear, effective presentations and communications. 
- Consulting Skillset: Strong communication skills, analytical thinking, attention to detail, ownership, teamwork, and intellectual curiosity, with the ability to work closely with business and technology stakeholders, synthesize ambiguity, ask thoughtful questions, identify gaps, and help drive work forward in a fast-paced, client-facing environment. 
- Financial Services Interest and Knowledge: Foundational understanding of, or demonstrated interest in, the financial services industry, including areas such as products, operations, regulatory requirements, technology, and business processes.

Additional Information
Compensation & Benefits 
Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow. 
Compensation 
- Base Salary: $80,000–$99,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law. 
- Annual Performance Bonus 
Benefits 
- Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP 
- 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options 
- College savings and student loan repayment programs 
- Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday 
- Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs 
Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Job Description
This practice is built for the way enterprise software actually gets made now: small senior pods, AI agents doing much of the build, and outcomes in weeks where traditional delivery approaches took months. We build digital products, AI agents, intelligent workflows and modernized platforms that help organizations operate differently across healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation and consumer industries. Working alongside AI Engineers and Data Engineers, you'll take opportunities from discovery through adoption, combining deep business understanding with a practical view of what technology can achieve. The person defining the product is also accountable for whether it gets used, which means you'll stay close to the outcome long after launch.
This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery. AI agents are changing how products are built, but they cannot decide what should be built in the first place. You'll work through ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and help clients move from broad ambitions to solutions that create lasting impact.
As part of the Digital Products & AI team, you can expect to:
- Lead discovery with clients to understand how work gets done, where value is being lost, and which opportunities are worth pursuing.
- Define product requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and success measures that guide delivery and enable measurable outcomes.
- Translate business challenges into products, AI-enabled solutions, and intelligent workflows that people will trust and adopt.
- Shape how AI capabilities are applied, including what should be automated, where human oversight is required, and how success should be evaluated.
- Drive adoption by aligning stakeholders, supporting change, and helping clients redesign processes where necessary to realize value.
- Create reusable approaches, assets, and industry insights that strengthen future engagements, with the strongest ideas becoming capabilities and offerings we take to market.

Product and strategy foundations

- Experience leading discovery, shaping product direction, and translating complex business challenges into actionable plans.
- Experience building business cases, defining success measures, and demonstrating value realization.

- Deep expertise in at least one industry sector, with the ability to quickly establish credibility with both operational and executive stakeholders.
- Working knowledge of AI-enabled products, including agents, retrieval approaches, automation, and the opportunities and limitations of modern AI systems.
- Experience evaluating competing opportunities and making informed decisions about where technology can create the greatest impact.
Enterprise delivery
- Experience working with multidisciplinary teams to deliver technology solutions from concept through implementation and adoption.
- Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence decisions across multiple levels of an organization.
- Commercial judgment and the ability to balance business value, user needs, technical feasibility, and delivery constraints.
Ideally, you'll also bring:
- Experience delivering solutions within consulting, professional services, or a leadership role within your industry.
- Experience in healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation, or consumer industries.
- Experience with change management, operating model design, process transformation, or driving adoption of new technologies.
- Experience using data, analytics, AI tools, SQL, Python, or similar approaches to support decision-making and product strategy.
